subject: result of mdply: leave out the parameters

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: result of mdply: leave out the parameters
parts:
Dear manipulatr,

Consider the following dummy example,

library(plyr)
params <- expand.grid(a=1:2, b=1:2)

foo <- function(a,b) data.frame(x=rnorm(1), y=rnorm(1))
results <- mdply(params, foo)

## a b x y
## 1 1 -0.2246094 -0.7117941
## 2 1 -0.6463376 0.8058824
## 1 2 -0.8369334 -1.0038994
## 2 2 -0.6519631 0.3111867

My problem is that I'm going to use the result in some matrix
calculation where the parameter values a and b should not appear.
There are ways to remove the unwanted columns, of course,

results <- results[ , !(names(results) %in% names(params))]

## x y
## -0.2246094 -0.7117941
## -0.6463376 0.8058824
## -0.8369334 -1.0038994
## -0.6519631 0.3111867

but I was hoping to see an option for this behavior directly in the
plyr package. Have I missed it?

Regards,

baptiste

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: result of mdply: leave out the parameters
parts:
I did try maply too, but for some reason the results are coerced into
a higher-dimensional object or in a different structure (array of
lists).

library(plyr)
params <- expand.grid(a=1:2, b=1:2)
foo <- function(a,b) data.frame(x=rnorm(1), y=rnorm(1))

maply(params, foo)
## b
## a 1 2
## 1 List,2 List,2
## 2 List,2 List,2

The closest I can get to the result I want (an efficient one-liner,
basically) is with mlply,

results <- do.call(rbind, mlply(params, foo))

Thanks,

baptiste

It looks like I did this deliberately:
http://github.com/hadley/plyr/commit/282e3501aa485388e933853ef9a4c20ef01e7849

because of http://github.com/hadley/plyr/issues/closed#issue/8

I think this is telling me that aaply and maply should work a little
different, or maybe that *aply needs an option to say whether every
variable/dimension in the original input should generate a dimension
in the output - sometimes you want that and sometimes you don't.

Hadley
